name: SpexCode
description: The spec tree of a task's repository, with drift and diagrams, beside the task. Start a task on a node or cite it; agents get SpexCode's skills and share a snapshot of the tree into a group, readable there and on phones.
subtitle: Spec tree, drift and diagrams

zh-CN.name: SpexCode
zh-CN.subtitle: 规格树、代码漂移与架构图
zh-CN.description: 任务旁边一格:它所在仓库的规格树——每个节点的正文、和代码的漂移、架构图。在节点上开一条新任务,或者把节点引用进这条任务;agent 拿到 SpexCode 的技能,还能把规格树的快照发进群,群里和手机上都能看。
examples: 给这个仓库画一份规格图
哪些规格和代码漂移了?
Draw the spec atlas of this repository
Which specs have drifted from the code?
author: SpexCode
